package main import ( "strconv" "github.com/vuka-lang/ui" ) // Counter embeds ui.Live: a live component, its markup its Render. type Counter struct { ui.Live Start int // a prop n int // server state } // Inc is an event. func (c *Counter) Inc() { c.n++ } // Parse reads a step with ?, as .vuka does. func (c *Counter) Parse(s string) Result[int] { n := strconv.Atoi(s)? return Ok(n) }
{Start + n}
